summary: Iter56 review: regime-phase fairness bugfixes + strategy-search presets everywhere. All 16 unit tests (test_regime_phase_fairness + test_search_presets_workbench) pass. 4 new API-level tests pass (regime-lab list exposes trend/nnfx per regime, engine defaults include sub_min_days=1.5, dynamic-workbench /start accepts both regime_presets payload and legacy body). Full frontend verification: Optimizer preset bar in params/discovery/combo/explore (hidden in dynamic), 8 chips, mean_reversion toggles rsi+bb_lower on and supertrend_dir off, objective=win_rate, time_exit on, leverage off, min_trades=30, max_rules=3, iterations=400, toast shown, 'on' marker clears on manual toggle. Dynamik-Werkbank discover tab shows dwb-preset-bar + dwb-preset-auto checkbox (toggles). Regime-Autopilot presets daytrading/reaktiv/swing/lang work (swing: 8/25, lang: plateau=1500). Regime-Lab per-regime panel: regime 0 shows 'Trendfolge ★', regime 2 (Seitwärts) shows 'Mean Reversion ★' with hint. New opt-group chips Trail-SL/Zeit-Exit/Entry-Ordertyp present. No console errors (only pre-existing Failed-to-fetch before auth seed).
critical_code_review_comments: Regime-Lab modal is quite large (RegimeLab.js ~1455 lines) – future refactor could split RegimeCard / BuildAndTest / AnalysisList into separate files for maintainability.
Dynamic workbench job slot is global (409 'Es läuft bereits ein Werkbank-/Regime-Lab-Job') – reset endpoint is handy but tests should always call it before start; consider documenting.
seed_data_creation: none; existing analysis ra_9f0077e5 'Test 5 Regime' used
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dynamic-workbench start requires POST /api/dynamic-workbench/reset first if a previous job is stuck (returns 409 otherwise). Stop endpoints are /api/dynamic-workbench/{action}/{jid} (action = stop|cancel|pause|resume). Regime-Lab per-regime preset bars only render after clicking regime-optimize-toggle-{scope}-{id} (scope='combined' for Test 5 Regime). FE preset auto-highlight in Optimizer: setting opt-ind-* via opt-preset-X adds class 'on' to the chip; manually toggling any indicator clears it.
rca of the issue: N/A – review request confirmed all new behaviour works as described.
